sources.head_base: The head model is a rigid shell whose neck stub flares at its base: the ring on the neck joint plane is 65 mm wide each side and 41 to 66 mm deep, the rows above it 46 to 51 mm. Turned with the head it swings those lobes out of the skin's neck, which takes only part of the turn, and over the collar beside the shoulder. With the skinned body drawn, shell vertices below height_m above the neck joint plane are held inside an ellipse round the neck axis (half width side_m, depth front_m forward and back_m behind) and drawn down the neck by drop_m at the joint plane, falling to nothing at height_m. A first version held them in a 30 mm circle. Measured 2026-11-20 on the default subject at the address, top, impact and finish poses with the head turned 1.4 rad either way: 9.2 to 17.5 mm outside the skin with no hold, 3.7 mm or more inside with the circle, 2.2 mm or more inside now. The circle opened the join under the jaw: the skin's neck rim stands 79 mm forward of the axis, the stub's front wall 62 mm (17 mm apart) and the circle 30 mm (49 mm apart), and the stub ends level with the rim, so a view from the front passed between them and out through the back of the neck. See-through pixels round the neck of a tour-average subject over a fitted driver swing (55 frames, four cameras, 480 px square, 0.6 m away): no hold 7,784, the circle 22,299, now 10,810; an ellipse 50 mm sideways with the front wall kept and drawn 10 % forward gave 5,844 but stands 12.3 mm outside the skin at the 1.4 rad turn. What the turn check leaves room for, to the millimetre and with 1 mm to spare: 48 to 55 mm forward, 31 to 34 mm sideways, 30 to 46 mm behind; front 0.052 came 1.5 mm outside, and a side or back wider than 30 mm changed the pixel count by under 1 %. Drop 0.010 gave 11,357, 0.015 10,251; 0.018 puts the base beside a fold of skin under the neck at the top pose (40 mm outside by the check). The slit behind the jaw seen face-on (501 pixels in the worst frame) is at the side, where a rigid base has no room, and stays. The loft body keeps the whole shell.
sources.head_base_limits: Check of head_base: with the head turned turn_rad either way at the top and finish poses of tests/fixtures/model_appearance/swing_poses.json, no head shell vertex below below_m above the neck joint plane may lie more than outside_m outside the posed skin (signed distance along the nearest skin vertex's normal). 1.4 rad is the head's turn against the chest at the top of a fitted driver swing (1.15 rad at its finish).
sources.head_join_limits: Check of head_base at the address, top, impact and finish poses of tests/fixtures/model_appearance/swing_poses.json. For each vertex of the skin's neck rim within sector_deg of straight ahead (head frame), the cover angle is the steepest dip below level at which a sight line over that vertex towards the neck axis still meets the head shell, taking shell points within window_deg of the vertex's direction; a steeper line passes under the shell's base into the open neck. Its mean over the front of the rim may not be under mean_cover_deg, nor any vertex under least_cover_deg. Measured 2026-11-20 (mean / least, degrees): no hold 31.9 to 45.4 / -0.7; the 30 mm circle 13.9 to 28.1 / -0.5; the ellipse with no drop 20.4 to 34.1 / -0.6; now 37.0 to 49.3 / 21.3. The mean bound is the unheld shell's own cover, rounded down; the least bound asks for the drop, without which the base ends level with the rim.
sources.wrist_blend: A skinned hand is drawn rigid on the club, so a forearm that follows only its own body leaves the hand's cuff at a bent wrist. Over the last wrist_blend_length_m (70 mm) before the wrist joint the forearm's skin passes smoothly (smoothstep) to the body the hand moves with, and is whole on it from wrist_blend_full_m (15 mm) before the joint: the skin's end ring, 10 mm before the joint, and the row behind it. 70 mm spreads a 60 degree bend over the lower quarter of the forearm; a length of 0 switches the blend off and leaves the bones as they were. Only with the skinned hands on a club.
sources.wrist_limits: Checks of the blend with a wrist bent bend_deg (30 degrees) each way in flexion and deviation. end_shift_m: the forearm's end may move this far against its hand's body; measured 0 (it is rigid with it), against 16.1 mm with the blend off; 0.2 mm is a tenth of the 2 mm the skin lies under the hand's wrist section (fit_settings.json, wrist_under_m). end_to_hand_m: largest distance from the forearm's end (ring and row behind) to the hand's surface in the MuJoCo model; measured 11.6 mm at every bend (the end ring itself 8.6 mm: it ends 8 mm behind the hand's rim and lies 2 mm inside it), against 16 to 29 mm for the end ring with the blend off (2026-11-20, default subject, wrist joints on the skinned hands').
sources.swing_limits: Bounds on the drawn surface at the swing-like poses of tests/fixtures/model_appearance/swing_poses.json, against the bind pose: the share of a layer's faces whose area changes by more than area_ratio either way, and the share turned against the surface around them. Measured 2026-11-20 on the default and the showpiece profile: at most 4.97 % stretched (shirt at the top, under the arms) and 0.52 % folded (shirt, 0.45 % of it at address already, on the garment hems). The bounds hold the present state with margin for another subject; they are not a quality target: single faces at the trouser hip crease and under the arm change area up to 26 times.
sources.covered_parts: Body parts (model_appearance.library classes) whose loft meshes the skin replaces; hands, head, feet and club keep their own models, and the head model's neck is left out because the skin has one.
sources.spine_follow: Share of the thorax's motion relative to the pelvis taken by the spine05, spine04 and spine03 group (the rest stays with the pelvis). 0.1, 0.45 and 0.8 are the #15299 prototype's values: the waistband stays on the pelvis and the lower ribs turn with the chest.
sources.weight_floor: A body share under 0.0001 of a vertex is dropped and the rest renormalised; it moves a vertex less than 0.1 mm per metre of relative body motion and keeps the bone lists short.
sources.bind_pose: Model coordinates (radians; every other coordinate zero) of the pose the bones are bound in: both arms hanging at the side, the closest model pose to the stored skin's rest pose, so the turn from one to the other is small and carries almost no twist about a bone.
sources.bind_stretch_limit_m: Largest change of an edge length allowed between the fitted rest pose and the bind pose. Measured 20.9 mm (2026-11-20) with the body origins of the 1.71 m default subject in tests/unit/model_appearance/test_body_skin_export.py, at the shoulder where the arm comes down from the stored rest pose; the bound leaves margin for a subject of another size.
